projects.notes: Weak source. Hosted on a consultant's ArcGIS Online account (item 'INDOT STIP (2024)', modified 2025-12-03), not by INDOT. Only DES number, route, location, WORKTYPE letter code and WORKDESC (154 distinct values; 20 listed); no cost, phase or letting date. All STIP entries are programmed work. INDOT's own server (https://gis.indot.in.gov/ro/rest/services, e.g. DOT/INDOT_NLRI_DATA/MapServer for Next Level Roads) answered HTTP 403 to every request, so nothing there could be verified.

parcels_statewide_note: Indiana's statewide layer (https://gisdata.in.gov/server/rest/services/Hosted/Parcel_Boundaries_of_Indiana_Current/FeatureServer/0, 3,682,675 parcels, verified) has NO owner name: only parcel ids (state_parcel_id, parcel_id), property address (prop_add, dlgf_prop_address), property class code and tax district. Useful for geometry and ids only.

parcels_counties.notes: City of Indianapolis/Marion County. Slow server: an unfiltered sample query timed out, a filtered query (owner name LIKE) answered. STATEPARCELNUMBER is the 18-digit state id. Value is assessed value.
Lake County, Indiana. No value field.
Hamilton County's own server, exported daily (EXPORTDATE). OWNNAME repeats the owner. Value is assessed value, AVTAXYR 2026.

Evansville-Vanderburgh County GIS 'Tax Parcels' (ArcGIS item eb92dc98ed854334a2ff7e8d2a708311, account EVC_ComputerServices, item modified 2025-10-29): 'current taxable property boundaries in Vanderburgh County IN. Tax ID, Ownership, property address'. Terms read on the item on 2026-11-19: a disclaimer only ('for convenience only ... Use of any of this information is at the user's own risk ... no warranties of any kind'); it states no limit on commercial use, redistribution, solicitation or mailing lists. 78,669 of 79,407 records have OWNER1; OWNER2 is a second owner; OwnerName repeats the name. maxRecordCount 80000.

Delaware County, Indiana GIS parcels joined to the Assessor's CAMA data (ArcGIS item d05f185c75d142fd961203304bc36de0; credits: Delaware County Office of Information & GIS Services and Assessor's Office). The description says it is updated weekly and is meant 'as an end point for external applications'; last edit 2026-11-16. Terms read on the item on 2026-11-19: a disclaimer only (convenience only, user's own risk, no warranties, no liability); no limit on commercial use, redistribution, solicitation or mailing lists is stated. 58,881 records have an owner name; the other 1,050 have no owner and a null 'Confidential' flag (every record with an owner has Confidential = 0). OwnerName2 is a second owner. No value field on this layer. maxRecordCount 2000.

parcels_counties.restrictions: terms not found (the item licence field and the layer description are empty; no county terms page was located on 2026-11-19)
parcels_counties.notes: 'Parcels' layer in the Office of the Monroe County Surveyor's 'Monroe_County_Survey_Utility' service (ArcGIS item c80c13c7d58846f0bbd73d5faa01806f, account MoCo_Surveyor), described as selected layers from the Monroe County GIS for land surveyors; loaded 2025-10-09, so it is a copy about a year old rather than a live file. Samples are Bloomington, IN parcels (PIN prefix 53). The City of Bloomington's own parcel service answered 403. maxRecordCount 1000.

parcels_counties_note: Not found or not reachable in the time allowed: Allen, St. Joseph.
summary: Projects: weak - only a consultant-hosted STIP line layer (DES number, location, work description; no cost or dates) could be verified; INDOT's own GIS server refuses requests with 403. Parcels: statewide layer has no owner names; owner layers verified for Marion, Lake and Hamilton counties. 2026-11-19: owner layers added for Vanderburgh and Delaware (disclaimer-only terms); Monroe recorded but held, terms not found. Allen, St. Joseph, Elkhart, Tippecanoe, Porter, Hendricks, Johnson, Madison and Clark: no county-published owner layer found in the ArcGIS catalogue.
